'''Revelation Bring Him Before Me''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star II: Throne Room|DS2-D-deathstariithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star II: Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Death Star II Throne Room Revelat.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck rocks!

The published list has 69 cards.

== Strategy ==

Get Vader to a battleground and do some damage! spideyguy0: IAO is get Vader to a battleground quickly. I would play it even if it didn't add to the forfeit of my characters.
